labels.title: Label for peripheral instance
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

init_type.title: resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: generate or not the ADC init code, call it or not at boot
init_type.$comment: generate the init code of your ADC or not (enabled/disabled), call it automatically at startup or not (called/enabled)

oneOf.title: Bulb
oneOf.description:
ADC conversions sampling phase starts immediately after end of conversion, stops upon trigger event.
Note: First conversion is using minimal sampling time (refer to hal_adc_sampling_time_t).
Note:  Usable only if conversions from ADC group regular (not ADC group injected) and not in continuous mode.

oneOf.title: Trigger control
oneOf.description:
ADC conversions sampling phase  by trigger events: trigger rising edge starts sampling, trigger falling edge stops sampling and start conversion.
Note: Usable only if conversions from ADC group regular (not ADC group injected) and not in continuous mode.

sampling_time.title: Sampling time
sampling_time.$comment: Sampling time can be, depending on ADC instance selected: channel wise (value with number of ADC clock cycles) or common to a group of channels (in this case, refer to configuration in ADC instance section).

labels.$comment: label associated to the instance of the peripheral, can be overridden at sample level. In this case it becomes read-only.

gain_compensation_x1000.title: Gain compensation
gain_compensation_x1000.description:
ADC data post-processing: ADC gain coefficient applies to raw conversions data. Value multiplicated by 1000 to have an integer value (example: to set coefficient 0.982, parameter value must be 982). Therefore, unitary gain corresponds to value 1000..
Note: Coefficient resolution managed by ADC peripheral is higher than 1/1000, if needed to reach more accurate resolution, refer to function LL_ADC_SetGainCompensation().

scope.description:
Oversampling scope: ADC groups regular and-or injected.
If ADC group injected conversion insertion within regular sequence:
- setting continued: when group injected is triggered, the oversampling on group regular is temporary stopped and continued afterwards.
- setting resumed: when group injected is triggered, the oversampling on group regular is resumed from start (oversampler buffer reset).
